messages:
PerfBot: :rotating_light: Nightly perf dashboard alert: p50 latency +18% and p95 +24% for the kernel-selection path on model: redwood-model-7b-quant (quantized). Spike starts ~2026-03-21T01:03:00Z. Affected pods: runtime-pool-3.*. Metric snapshot: `kernel_selector.latency.p50: 42ms -> 50ms`, `kv.cache.hit_rate: 0.82 -> 0.60`.

Maya: saw this alert just now, I'm on it. any recent rollouts?

Kevin: there was a small config change rolled last night around 00:40 UTC: `prefer_streaming_kernels: true` flip in rollout 2026-03-21T00:39:12 by Sasha.

Sasha: yep that change went to canary then global. It was intended to reduce memory pressure on A100s. I can revert if it's the culprit.

Maya: quick check: can we confirm whether kernel selector is choosing different kernels for long vs short seqs? perf dashboard shows a bump on short-seq workloads.

Jun: running a quick query against traces. command: ```bash
kubectl -n inference logs deployment/runtime-pool-3 --since=2h | grep kernel_selector | tail -n 200
```

Jun: log snippet: ```
[2026-03-21T00:58:47Z] kernel_selector: chosen=streamed_matmul_v2, seq=32, estimated_latency=12.3ms
[2026-03-21T00:58:48Z] kernel_selector: chosen=blocked_matmul_v1, seq=32, estimated_latency=28.7ms
[2026-03-21T00:59:01Z] cache: kv_hit=false, key=prefix:abc123
```

Alex: that alternating chosen kernels for same seq length is suspicious. could be nondeterministic selection based on micro-batching timing.

Kevin: starting a quick bisect on the config + kernel selector commit range. candidate range: commits 9f3a..d4b1. I'll try to repro locally with the nightly perf harness.

Maya: note from console: traffic routing fallback fired for one customer and switched to model-7b-fp16 for ~2m. Might've masked some failure signals.

Sasha: if revert is quickest, I can push a rollback to canary first. Reverting `prefer_streaming_kernels` toggle is low-risk. Want me to do that now?

Jun: hold for 5m, I'm collecting traces + kernel selection histogram from prod. sending a link when ready.

PerfBot: Added alert ticket infra#2456 and attached metric timeseries.

Kevin: local perf harness reproduced p50 regression when `prefer_streaming_kernels=true` + batch size 1 with cold KV cache. Repro steps: ```bash
# reproduce
python perf_harness.py --model redwood-model-7b-quant --batch 1 --seq 32 --prefer-streaming true --cold-cache
```

Maya: good repro. Sasha please revert on canary and let's watch the dashboard for 10m before global revert.

Sasha: reverting canary now. command: `kubectl -n infra set env deployment/runtime-pool-3 PREFER_STREAMING_KERNELS=false --record`

Alex: I'll open a short runbook note: suspected interaction between streaming kernel selection and KV cache warming. Will add to the kernel-selector issue.

Jun: traces after revert: kernel_selector stabilized to `blocked_matmul_v1` for seq=32, kv_hit_rate recovered to 0.79 -> 0.83 over 7m. Dashboards showing p50 back to baseline.

Maya: status: canary revert looks good. No rollout revert required yet. Keeping on pager watch for 30m.

Kevin: follow-up action items: 1) add deterministic selection override for short-seq hot path 2) add unit test in kernel-selector to avoid oscillation 3) add CI perf test with cold KV scenarios.

Sasha: ack. I'll open the revert PR notes and start a follow-up for deterministic selector.

PerfBot: Incident resolved for alert infra#2456 (status: mitigated). Logged timeline and commits: reverted toggle by Sasha (commit ab12f).

Maya: thanks everyone. filing a retro and linking traces + perf-harness run results. :thumbsup:
